claims.text: The proposed model trains significantly faster than baseline methods, taking under 30 hours compared to up to 6 days for baselines.
The model shows improved retrieval accuracy and cluster formation compared to baseline implementations, particularly in recipe retrieval tasks.
Qualitative results indicate that the model offers more flexibility for dataset alterations than baseline methods.
